description: Department of Elections - Amendment to the Notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1928/3 of 19.08.2015
reasoning: This gazette content specifically announces corrections to the official declaration of elected Members of Parliament following the Parliamentary General Election held on 17.08.2015. It is published by the Commissioner of Elections and contains the names of elected representatives by electoral district. This content falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers election results and declarations.
